caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling an ornate vessel or lamp with a handle, placed on a shallow, round tray. The main body of the vessel is bulbous at the top, tapering into a narrower, intricately shaped stem that flares outward above a circular base. The stem features several rounded and flared sections, creating a decorative silhouette. A handle extends from the midsection, curving outward and upward in a smooth arc before looping inward at the end. At the top of the vessel is a cylindrical component with a long, thin rod extending vertically from its center. The rod and the cylindrical section appear to be rendered in a brass or gold tone, while the rest of the vessel and the tray are shaded in black and dark gray, suggesting a metal material. The drawing is centered within a rectangular border on a beige background, with the composition dominated by vertical elements and symmetrical shapes.
title: Camphene Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
